name: GTG-14021
description: A China-based public-and-state-security "stability maintenance" and transnational-repression operation, run from inside the PRC via VPN/v2ray access (device timezone consistently UTC+8 regardless of exit node), targeting Hong Kong pro-democracy figures, Tiananmen-commemoration organizers, Uyghur advocacy groups, and overseas dissidents — in one case producing "pre-operational venue intelligence" on planned overseas protests (a Vancouver march route, Uyghur events in Turkey, the Oslo Freedom Forum). Anthropic
